title: UDP Migration Spec: Manifest Visuals
subtitle: Exactly what moves from PowerReact into the UDP monorepo to support the visual library, the gallery and the manifest reader
companion: Manifest Visuals: Architecture and UDP Integration (team document)

$STENCIL.what: New folder; mirrors $PKG one level down

$MANIFEST.what: New folder for the manifest engine and reader

$STATIC.what: The host app’s static assets folder (served from the app origin)

actions.COPY: Copy byte for byte. Change only the import paths the item lists.
actions.EXTRACT: Copy only the named symbols into the new file; leave the rest of the source behind.
actions.ADAPT: Port the file; replace only the imports and components the item lists. Keep logic, names and tests.
actions.NEW: Create in UDP following the pattern given; nothing equivalent exists in PowerReact.
actions.REGENERATE: Do not copy: the UDP build produces it.
actions.REPLACE: Do not move: use the named UDP component or service instead.
actions.REFERENCE: Do not move: use it as the specification for code the UDP team writes elsewhere.

dependencies.name: lucide
dependencies.status: New, unless V11 maps the icons to UDP’s registry

invariants: Tags `udp-pbi-*`, classes `UdpPbi*`, event names (`dataPointClick`, `exportData`, `focusModeChange`, `viewChange`) and every public prop name.
Manifest component names `Univerus*` and `schemaVersion: 1`: they are the contract with Univerus-Lens.
Components are presentational: they never fetch, never build DAX. Data in as props, events out.
Colours only through `--pbi-*` roles; `--u-*` is read only in tokens-bridge.css; no literal colours.
Filters reach DAX only through `injectCrossFilters` (one `TREATAS` per filter); a clicked value is never concatenated into a query.
Destination layout mirrors $PKG under $STENCIL, so relative imports and `styleUrls` stay valid.
No secrets, `.env` files or tenant data move. Seed manifests use demo ids only.

decisions.question: Unit-test runner for the enterprise library (its `test` script is lint + build today)
decisions.proposal: Add Vitest with a `test:unit` script (the manifest tests are Vitest)

decisions.question: Icons: `lucide` or UDP’s icon registry (V11)
decisions.proposal: UDP registry if it covers the 38 icons; else add `lucide`

decisions.question: Identity for C1: user token or service principal
decisions.proposal: User token (MSAL) for row-level-security or SSO models; service principal elsewhere

decisions.question: Where manifests live (C2) and who publishes
decisions.proposal: UDP API + database, per tenant, versioned; Lens publishes

decisions.question: Static path for `/geo` in each host app (A01)
Adopt `univerus-theme.css` (A05) for the approved Univerus look
decisions.proposal: Yes on report pages (`frame="card"`); Fluent fallback elsewhere

App shell and pages unrelated to manifests: `src/components/{briefing,chat,embed,layout,visuals}`, `src/pages/*` except ManifestPreview (M18) and Gallery (content only, V13).
`src/store/daxLog.ts` (DAX inspector) and `src/store/filters.ts` beyond the cross-filter slice (M08).
Build and tooling of PowerReact: `stencil.config.ts`, Vite, Tailwind, Playwright config, `index.html`, `packages/udp-powerbi-visuals/{index.js, components/, hydrate/, dist/, docs/}`.

contracts.C1:
POST {tenantV2ApiUrl}/powerbi/query
Authorization: Bearer <UDP user token>

Request  { "query": "EVALUATE …",            // one top-level EVALUATE (schema-checked)
           "workspaceId": "<uuid>",
           "datasetId":   "<uuid>" }          // must be in the tenant's allow-list

200      { "success": true, "rows": [ { "table[Column]": …, "[Measure]": … } ],
           "rowCount": 12, "executionTimeMs": 140 }
403      { "success": false, "error": "Dataset … is not allowed", "hint": "…" }
4xx/5xx  { "success": false, "error": "DAX Query Execution failed", "hint": "…", "details": … }

Upstream: POST https://api.powerbi.com/v1.0/myorg/groups/{workspaceId}/datasets/{datasetId}/executeQueries
          { "queries": [{ "query": … }], "serializerSettings": { "includeNulls": true },
            "impersonatedUserName": "<UPN>" }    // only for row-level-security models
Limits:   100,000 rows or 1,000,000 values, 15 MB, one table per query;
          120 requests / minute / identity → cache by DAX text, per-user tokens.
contracts.C2:
GET  {tenantV2ApiUrl}/manifests              → [ { id, title, version, updatedAt } ]
GET  {tenantV2ApiUrl}/manifests/{id}?version= → the manifest JSON
PUT  {tenantV2ApiUrl}/manifests/{id}         → validates against manifest.schema.json,
                                               stores a new version, returns { id, version }
Scope: per tenant. Keep the previous version for rollback.
